bettermusictoast.config.title: Better Music Toast
bettermusictoast.option.enabled.tooltip: Shows which song is currently playing in the game.
bettermusictoast.option.position.tooltip: Where on the screen the display appears.
bettermusictoast.option.displayMode.tool:
Whole Song: stays visible while the song plays.
Timed: disappears after the configured number of seconds.
bettermusictoast.option.duration.tooltip: How long the display stays visible in "Timed" mode. The timer pauses while it is covered or a menu is open (unless "Show in Menus" is on).
bettermusictoast.option.avoidMode.toolti: What happens when an advancement, recipe, effect icons, a boss bar or an action bar message appears in the same spot.
bettermusictoast.option.size.tooltip: Size of the display. Only sizes that keep the font sharp are offered; how many depends on your GUI scale.
bettermusictoast.option.showArtist.toolt: Shows the composer below the song title.
bettermusictoast.option.showMusicDiscs.t: Also shows music from nearby jukeboxes.
bettermusictoast.option.musicStyle.toolt:
Mixed: all songs, like vanilla.
Classic: only C418's original soundtrack. Applies from the next song on, music discs are not affected.
bettermusictoast.option.showInMenus.tool: Also shows the song in the pause menu, inventory, settings and title screen, not just in-game.
bettermusictoast.option.hideVanillaToast: Hides Minecraft's own music toast everywhere: on song changes, over menus and in the pause menu. While enabled, the vanilla setting below is greyed out.
bettermusictoast.preview.title: Sample Song
bettermusictoast.soundOptions.button.too: Better Music Toast settings: position, duration, size and Minecraft's own music toast.
